entities.name: Monetize
entities.description: The Genuin product line under which the Ad Prioritisation Logic for Video Feed Placements is defined.

entities.name: Video Feed Placement
entities.description: A placement that serves paginated video feeds in calls of 10 videos each, configurable with managed ad types and prioritisation logic.

entities.name: Ad Prioritisation Logic
entities.description: The rule system that determines which ads appear in each page of 10 videos on a placement based on ad type, CPM, and configuration.

entities.name: Sponsored Takeover
entities.description: A managed ad type that occupies the entire 10-slot paginated view exclusively, ordered by CPM and configurable with creative videos and duration.

entities.name: Sponsored Post
entities.description: A managed ad type that occupies only the designated in-feed ad slots within a paginated view and competes by CPM among posts.

entities.name: Programmatic Ad
entities.description: Fallback ad type that fills in-feed ad slots not claimed by sponsored posts or after sponsored post budgets are exhausted.

entities.name: Organic Content
entities.description: Non-ad video content used to fill slots not occupied by takeover or sponsored post creative videos when allowed.

entities.name: CPM
entities.description: The bid value of a takeover or sponsored post; used to order competing ads with highest CPM activating first.

entities.name: Duration
entities.description: The flight window within which an ad is eligible to serve on a placement.

entities.name: Number of Creative Videos
entities.description: The set of videos a sponsor has supplied for an ad, which determines how many slots can be filled by sponsor content per page.

entities.name: In-feed Ad Slots Per Page
entities.description: Placement-level configuration of how many of the 10 slots in a paginated view are reserved for in-feed ads; applies to sponsored posts only.

entities.name: Allow Content To Play With Sponsored Takeover
aliases: Allow content to play with sponsored takeover
entities.description: A per-takeover configuration controlling whether organic content fills slots not occupied by takeover creative videos; when disabled, remaining slots are empty and takeovers require a 5-video minimum.

entities.name: Takeover Minimum Video Requirement
entities.description: Rule that takeovers demand a minimum of 5 creative videos, so with Allow Content disabled the backend sends between 5 and 10 takeover videos per pagination.

entities.name: Sliding Window Cycling
entities.description: Algorithm where a window of N slots advances cyclically through a sponsor's video set each page when there are more creative videos than slots.

entities.name: Paginated View
entities.description: A single page of 10 video slots served by the video feed placement; the unit at which prioritisation and slot allocation are applied.

entities.name: Takeover Priority Order
entities.description: Rule that the highest CPM takeover runs exclusively until its budget or duration is exhausted, then the next highest CPM takeover activates.

entities.name: Sponsored Post Priority Order
entities.description: Rule that the highest CPM sponsored post is activated first and cycles to fill all in-feed slots until its budget is exhausted, before the next CPM post runs.

entities.name: Takeover Exclusivity Rule
entities.description: Rule that only one takeover can appear in a single paginated view and all sponsored posts and programmatic ads are suppressed while a takeover is active.

entities.name: Programmatic Fallback
entities.description: Behaviour where in-feed slots not filled by any active sponsored post fall back to programmatic ads.

entities.name: Frontend SDK
entities.description: Client SDKs expected to dynamically adjust viewports depending on the number of takeover videos (5-10) sent per pagination when Allow Content is disabled.

entities.name: Backend
entities.description: The server-side component that sends between 5 and 10 takeover videos to the frontend per pagination when Allow Content is disabled.

entities.name: User-Level Frequency Caps
entities.description: Planned per-user-per-day or per-session ceiling on how many times a specific sponsored post creative can be shown to the same user, diversifying user experience while preserving CPM-driven delivery.

entities.name: Budget Exhaustion
entities.description: State in which an ad's budget or duration has been consumed, triggering activation of the next highest CPM eligible ad or fallback to programmatic.

entities.name: User
entities.description: An end viewer of the video feed whose experience can include repeated exposure to the active sponsored post's creatives, to be diversified by future frequency caps.

relationships.description: The Ad Prioritisation Logic is part of the Monetize product.
Video feed placements are a feature of the Monetize product.
Ad Prioritisation Logic governs how ads are served on video feed placements.
Sponsored Takeovers are a managed ad type configurable on video feed placements.
Sponsored Posts are a managed ad type configurable on video feed placements.
Programmatic ads serve as a fallback ad type on video feed placements.
Sponsored Takeovers are ordered and prioritised by their CPM values.
Sponsored Posts compete and are prioritised by CPM.
Sponsored Takeovers are configured with a duration that defines their eligible flight window.
Sponsored Posts are configured with a duration that defines their eligible flight window.
Takeovers are configured with a number of creative videos that fill slots on each page.
Sponsored Posts are configured with a number of creative videos that cycle into in-feed slots.
Sponsored Posts can only occupy the in-feed ad slots configured on the placement.

relationships.source: Allow Content To Play With Sponsored Takeover
relationships.description: The Allow Content setting is a per-takeover configuration that controls organic interleaving on takeover pages.

relationships.source: Allow Content To Play With Sponsored Takeover
relationships.description: When enabled, the setting permits organic content to fill takeover slots not occupied by creative videos.
Takeovers require a minimum of 5 creative videos, especially when Allow Content is disabled.

relationships.target: Allow Content To Play With Sponsored Takeover
relationships.description: The 5-10 video minimum behaviour is triggered when the Allow Content setting is disabled on a takeover.
Takeovers with more videos than slots use sliding window cycling to advance through creatives each page.
Sponsored Posts use sliding window cycling to fill in-feed slots from their creative video set each page.
Takeover Priority Order is a rule within the Ad Prioritisation Logic.
Sponsored Post Priority Order is a rule within the Ad Prioritisation Logic.
The Takeover Exclusivity Rule is a constraint within the Ad Prioritisation Logic.
Programmatic Fallback is a behaviour defined within the Ad Prioritisation Logic.
The exclusivity rule suppresses all sponsored posts whenever a takeover is active on the placement.
The exclusivity rule restricts a paginated view to a single takeover with no co-existing ad types.
Programmatic Fallback fills unfilled in-feed slots with programmatic ads.
Programmatic fallback activates only after sponsored post budgets are exhausted or in-feed slots remain unfilled.
A takeover occupies the entire paginated view when active.
Sponsored posts occupy the in-feed slots within the paginated view.
Frontend SDKs must dynamically adjust viewports based on the number of takeover videos (5-10) per pagination.
The backend sends 5-10 takeover videos to the frontend SDKs per pagination when Allow Content is disabled.
The backend determines and sends the takeover video set per pagination based on the Allow Content configuration.
Frequency caps will limit how many times a sponsored post's creatives can be shown to the same user.
Frequency caps apply per-user-per-day or per-session to diversify user experience.
Frequency caps may in the future also be applied to Sponsored Takeovers, though that is out of scope for the current release.
When a takeover's budget is exhausted, the next highest CPM takeover activates.
When the active sponsored post's budget is exhausted, the next highest CPM sponsored post activates.
Exhaustion of all sponsored post budgets triggers programmatic fallback into the in-feed slots.
Users view the paginated video feed served by the placement and may see repeated sponsored creatives across pages.
